html:
Nonprofit Website Design Services

You can get a custom website design from Everbuilt Studio. Everbuilt Studio offers website design services for nonprofits.

How it Works for Nonprofits

You can start with a free homepage remake. No call or payment details are required. You get to keep the design if you do not like it. The launch package costs $2,950. It includes up to 5 pages, custom design, and basic SEO. You get your website in about a week.

What You Get and What it Costs

You own your website outright. You pay $0/month for hosting on Cloudflare Pages and GitHub. The launch package costs $2,950. You pay 50% deposit upfront and the balance at launch. After launch, you get 90 days of free care. Then you can choose optional care plans for $295/month or $595/month.

FAQ

What kind of support can I expect after launch? You get 90 days of free care after launch. Then you can choose from optional care plans at $295/month or $595/month. You can cancel at any time. What is included in the Signature package? The Signature package includes unlimited sections, galleries, admin panel, spreadsheet events, email and form integrations, and costs $7,500. How long does it take to launch a website with the Launch package? The launch package takes about a week.

Get started with your nonprofit website design project on our custom website launch package page.
